title: Order To Cash — Overview
description: observability_dashboards (phase 22). Five panels, each proven against real Prometheus data before being committed here: saga duration, per-service latency, consumer lag, outbox lag and DLQ depth. See progress/impl_observability_dashboards.md for the verified PromQL and the consumer-lag instrumentation decision (danielqsj/kafka-exporter, real broker consumer-group offsets — no service under apps/ computes its own lag).

panels.title: Saga duration (order.placed → completed/cancelled)
panels.description: otc_saga_completion_ms — p50/p95, by outcome (completed vs cancelled). Recorded once per closed saga (SagaFactHandler), so this fills in as real orders complete or are cancelled.

panels.title: Per-service latency (Gateway request / Orders fact-consume)
panels.description: otc_request_latency_ms (Gateway, per REST endpoint) and otc_fact_processing_latency_ms (Orders, per Kafka consumer) — the two OTel Meter bootstraps this repo currently runs (design.md §4.5 scoped metrics to Orders/Gateway only). p95, by service + endpoint/consumer.

panels.title: Kafka consumer lag (by consumer group / topic)
panels.description: kafka_consumergroup_lag, from danielqsj/kafka-exporter querying the REAL broker consumer-group offsets vs each topic's high-water mark (docker-compose.infra.yml's kafka-exporter service) — no service under apps/ instruments its own consumer lag, so this is the broker's own truth rather than an in-app proxy. 0 means fully caught up; a positive value is genuine unconsumed backlog.

panels.title: Outbox lag (oldest unpublished fact)
panels.description: otc_outbox_lag_ms — OutboxRelay.recordOutboxLag(), the age of the oldest row still awaiting publish, measured before every poll. 0 when fully caught up.

panels.title: DLQ depth (by topic)
panels.description: otc_dlq_depth — KafkaDlqDepth, a real broker admin-client Σ(high−low) partition-offset query per .dlq topic, polled on the same interval as the outbox relay. A non-zero, non-decreasing value is a genuine parked-message backlog that R16's DLQ contract expects an operator to drain.
